attBesluta.text: Love it! This purchase was for a corner cabinet and it fits perfectly. Definitely recommend this item.
The storage basket has two layers and can hold a lot. It's made of chrome-plated steel, looks nice, and is convenient for kitchen storage.
Excellent quality. Good price as usual. I love it. Perfect for a corner in my workshop. It feels nice and solid. I like it a lot. Must have for any corners
El producto cumple bien la función a la que está destinado. Su instalación es sencilla y fácil manejo. Referente al envío llegó en el plazo previsto.
Un peu compliqué à monter seul. Cela fait déjà plusieurs mois qu'ils sont installé et toujours satisfaite.
Muy funcional d buena calidad,lo volvería a comprar
Excellent product. Went up easy and comes with lots of sturdy hooks. Well packaged.
Surprisingly functional, easy to use, moves large heavy pots with minimal effort. Works well for senior gardener moving large seasonal pots.
Easy to assemble. Works as described. No more heavy lifting for me.

This has been a big help for moving both indoor and outdoor plant containers. I also used it to take a big bag of heavy debris to the trash bin. Wish I would have known about this years ago! It was also very easy to put together.

Thankyou hopefully saves our backs from moving heavy plants pots,price was reasonable, delivery not too bad, unfortunately we couldn't upload photo,site is pretty hard to navigate,it was for me anyway
Easy to assemble and use. Not a bad price for the purpose and quality I use it to move heavy items and plants from the greenhouse and shed.

This thing works even better than I had anticipated. My plants aren't huge, but they're heavy enough that I am very glad to have this tool to save my back. It keeps them secure. Love it! Looks to be nice quality.

Espérate que salgo muy útil y sirve para lo que está diseñado. Pero no tiene posibilidades de plegado ágil para guardarlo y se convierte en un cacharro bastante grande. Si tienes un jardín grande con una buena caseta para guardarlo es ideal. Lo devolví por excesivo tamaño una vez montado.
praktische Hilfe, wenn du einen größeren Topf umstellen musst
fast dispatch well packed good quality board i lost the included document tacts lol at me i have brought a lot of vevor products and very happy with them as well

I bought this board to decorate my home office and keep track of my to-do lists, and it's exceeded all my expectations. It's not just functional, it's also really beautiful - the white frame and neutral surface fit perfectly with my home decor. I use it every day for my work tasks, personal goals and even to display my favorite photos and postcards. It's become one of my favorite items in my office!

I was looking for a simple but effective notice board for my small apartment and this one fits the bill perfectly. The whiteboard is smooth and easy to write on, the corkboard is dense and holds pins securely, and the frame is solid and well-made. It's the perfect size for a small space, not too bulky but big enough for all my notes and reminders. Very happy with this purchase, it's great value for what you get.
Huge for its value super easy to clean and the cork on the bottom is a great touch.

My board came with this dent/crease going down the middle of it. Shipping date kept changing several times. Really needed this asap so it’ll be a hassle to return it. I like how large it is and the mini bulletin board to keep up with the kids sports and family trips.

This was a replacement for a Petsafe door. There is no comparison. The Petsafe door was all plastic and became brittle and cracked in the cold weather. This one is aluminum frame, seams very sturdy. I don’t the cold weather will bother it. It also has a third insulating flap which Wii definitely help in the cold. Strongly recommend
Put this in myself ( I’m 76 female) I have done 4 others through the years. This one is the easiest one I’ve ever done. Fits perfectly!

Quality material, made mostly of metal so the dogs won't ruin it quickly. The flaps work well amd my dogs learned very quickly to use. I installed it in a block wall of a garage and even though its supposed to be a little bit thinner of a wall I was able to make it connect and work. Very happy with the product.

I purchased for mounting,4x4 fence posts on a concrete retainer wall, with only two side flanges, should have purchased the ones with 4 tabs which may have had better support and less flexibility, otherwise they did the job. Ordered 10 pac to cover two separate jobs, just get the ones with 4 tabs to get more stability. The supplied concrete bolts and sleeves worked well. The screwed supued seemed more like metal thread screws so I used longer deck screws to attach to the posts

This plier set is very well made is it a very good price and like I said before I bought many things from this company and I don't have a complaint on anything I bought battery operated tools and other tools and I'm very happy with their products I would highly recommend this set.
Very nice heavy duty pliers! Unbeatable price. Shipping is always quick with Vevor. Great products from a great company!!!
Please use the previous post because it reflects these tools also! Very reliable, cost worthy, durable and built to last a lifetime!!!
I gave these sets to each of my sons for Christmas. They were so happy with their gift of tools.
Slices through steel like a termite to wood. Needed a bit of practice to get proficient.

This thing is Sweet!!! I had a project that I needed to cut expanded metal and the nibblers were struggling so I tried this and after a second or two of figuring it out it zipped along. The drill and tool got a bit hot but turned out fine!
I’ve used this several times and it has worked flawlessly

Works great! It's a little tricky to figure out, but once you get it going it nibbles away! I used it to cut trapezoid roofing 0,5mm thick, and it cuts like butter. It's difficult to cut crosswise due to the shape, but it works. I'm impressed with all the attachments and spare parts supplied! Very happy with the purchase!
